acceptanceCriteria: Playwright 1.64.0 is qualified by a retained live run (or refused with a documented local qualification procedure), traced to new PWP-V0 requirements
A version refusal writes a typed refusal JSON naming the qualified versions to stdout instead of a 0-byte document
Focused jstestprovider tests pass and fail without the fix
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1263: corvint-js-test-provider e2e --external-server --runner-version=1.64.0 refuses with external-playwright-version-unqualified (qualifiedPlaywrightVersion in internal/jstestprovider/external.go admits only 1.60.0/1.63.0) and leaves a 0-byte stdout document. Expected: 1.64.0 qualified via live run per playwright-external-provider-v0, and a typed refusal document on stdout naming qualified versions.
title: External JS test provider refuses Playwright 1.64.0 and writes an empty stdout document on refusal (#1263)
